specs.title: BUD-00: Blossom Upgrade Documents
specs.summary: Defines the language every other BUD is written in, and what a blob is: raw binary data addressed by the sha256 hash of that data.

specs.title: BUD-01: Server requirements and blob retrieval
specs.summary: The base every Blossom server implements: the CORS headers, the error reporting, and the GET and HEAD endpoints that serve a blob by its hash.

specs.title: BUD-02: Blob upload
specs.summary: Defines PUT /upload and the blob descriptor, the JSON object describing a stored blob: its url, hash, size, mime type and upload time.

specs.title: BUD-03: User Server List
specs.summary: Defines kind 10063, the replaceable event where a user lists the Blossom servers holding their blobs, most trusted first.

specs.title: BUD-04: Mirroring blobs
specs.summary: Defines PUT /mirror, which asks a server to fetch a blob from a URL itself instead of having the client upload the same bytes twice.

specs.title: BUD-05: Media optimization endpoints
specs.summary: Defines PUT /media, where a server transcodes and optimises what it is given rather than storing the bytes untouched.

specs.title: BUD-06: Upload requirements
specs.summary: Defines HEAD /upload, a preflight request telling a client whether an upload would be accepted before it sends the bytes.

specs.title: BUD-07: Paid upload and download
specs.summary: How a server charges for an endpoint: a 402 response carrying the payment terms, for uploads, downloads or media processing.

specs.title: BUD-08: Nostr File Metadata Tags
specs.summary: How a server returns NIP-94 file metadata alongside a blob descriptor, so a client can publish the file without recomputing it.

specs.title: BUD-09: Blob Report
specs.summary: Defines PUT /report, where a client submits a signed NIP-56 report naming the blobs it objects to.

specs.title: BUD-10: Blossom URI Schema
specs.summary: Defines the blossom: URI, which carries a blob hash, its extension, and hints about the servers where it can be found.

specs.title: BUD-11: Nostr Authorization
specs.summary: Defines the kind 24242 event a user signs to prove to a server that they allowed an application to act on their behalf.

specs.title: BUD-12: Blob management endpoints
specs.summary: Defines the management endpoints: listing what a pubkey uploaded, and deleting a blob by its hash.
